items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: She joined us - we came into New York in '36, when Billie Holiday joined us in 1937. She stayed with us nearly a year.

ctx.x: Allen MacMillan was the publicity representative for Mr. Louis Armstrong until he passed.
And only for Miss Billie Holiday... O.K., he's the greatest man.
He's a great man and he's still with the press today, 1973.
